notes: Single edition covered (2025). No older-edition galleries exist on the site.
Page structure: MetaSlider highlight carousel at top (58 unique photos), then an Elementor nested-tabs widget with one tab per in-person day and h6 subheadings per activity.
Displayed images use the Elementor 2000x1000 crop; fullsize_url is the verified (HTTP 200 via HEAD) original upload, preferring the un-scaled camera original over the WordPress -scaled variant.
fullsize candidates that returned 404 fall back to the -scaled variant.
